details.t: 3D Nails & concept
Art director, 3D designer, photographer, stylist, makeup artist, hair stylist, editor
Build an alien world and create its artifacts.

Two parallel worlds collide and become obsessed with each other’s beauty. Aliens try to look human, and humans try to look alien. I 3D sculpted the aliens’ natural nails and a wearable press-on set for humans inspired by them, then created a photoshoot with fashion magazine covers from both worlds.
3D alien nails, 3D press-on nail set, photoshoot, magazine covers
Brand Identity Proposal
Art director, graphic designer
Create a visual identity for Acté Atelier, a lingerie brand designed around women’s hormonal health.

The logo combines three shapes: the uterus, a pair of panties and the letter A. Repeated as a pattern, the mark turned into something that resembles lace, connecting the brand’s focus on hormonal health with the craft of lingerie.
Logo, pattern, color palette, mockups
AI Visual Exploration. Hyper Island client project
Team lead, AI and LoRA researcher, AI stills (LoRA training and generation)
Explore how Haglöfs can integrate AI into their existing e-commerce photography to make it feel more premium, and create a roadmap for doing it at scale.

We created a visual direction and experimented with training LoRA models on Haglöfs’ existing images, to keep a consistent visual style across stills and video at a large scale. The result was a proposal and research base for Haglöfs to take the work forward in-house.

Team lead, PR and affiliate strategist, photographer sourcing, e-commerce and social media guidelines, assisting graphic designer and art director
Rebrand L8 Hasselblad, a jewelry brand by designer Lotta Hasselblad, with a new brand book and visual direction.

L8 Hasselblad is known for its playful creativity and bold use of color. Lotta wanted to be seen as more premium, since her collection ranges from affordable pieces to high-end jewelry. We kept the colorful, expressive energy but refined it into a cleaner, more premium identity.

details.t: Brand Identity
Art director, graphic designer
Create a visual identity for Mamika Suzuki, a handmade silver jewelry brand.

The logo combines an M and an S, based on Mamika’s own drawing and shaped like melted silver, reflecting her handmade process. The client wanted purple, so I chose a deep shade to give the brand a mysterious feel, paired with off-white for a softer contrast than pure white.
Logo, wordmark, brand colors, photography direction, mockups
E-commerce Photography
Art director, photographer
Create product photography for Mamika Suzuki’s online store, following the new brand direction.

To make the brand feel mysterious, the photos are dark with a completely black background, leaving space for the hand and the silver jewelry to stand out. The contrast lets the silver catch the light, which highlights the handmade details.
